FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Military System Refactor
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description:
This update features a hefty refactor of Empire's military system, largely in the name of future extensibility. Some of the changes won't be evident to the player, but many will; and in time, this refactor should allow for further new and requested features.

This update *does* make some fairly substantial changes to how squads work. If you don't like those changes -- or any of the other changes -- then the latest 1.3.x version of Empire will be available in the releases section of the official Empire Refactored github. But once 1.5.x hits the steam workshop, support for 1.3.x will cease.

1.5.x should be save compatible with previous versions, but active battles or military events might behave a little weirdly.

patchNoteLines.li: Auto-resolve battles now play out round-by-round over time, complete with a window to watch the battle's progress. Now you can see all of the RNG and math that goes into determining an auto-resolve result.
Battle Reports for both auto- and manual-battles are archived in the Military main tab. Reports for auto-battles include the round-by-round progress.
Multiple simultaneous attacks on the same settlement are now supported. The mod currently doesn't actually *use* this behavior, but it opens the door to lots of fun stuff in the future.
The reward for an Overwhelming Victory has been changed from cooldown elimination to a small happiness and loyalty boost.

Added Crushing Defeat, the opposite of Overwhelming Victory. A Crushing Defeat is when you're defeated without inflicting a single casualty on the opposing force. The penalties for Crushing Defeat are more severe than for regular defeats.

Squads have been completely reworked. No longer do you design a squad and then assign it to a settlement for free. Now, you must hire each individual squad. Furthermore, squads will not automatically update if you change their associated template; you have to pay to update them. And if a member of the squad dies, you'll need to hire a replacement. Squads aren't a free lunch anymore, pal!
(There are options in the settings to reduce the hire/upgrade cost for squads. If you *really* hate paying for things, you can drop the costs to 0, to emulate older Empire behavior.)
Injured squad members will heal over time. A squad that is deployed with injured members will not be as effective as when it's completely healthy.
All deployments and offensive operations cost 20% of the squad's value. This was technically already true for deployments, but this update surfaces that cost in the UI and sends you a bill.
Post-deployment squad cooldowns have been mostly replaced with travel time based on the distance back to their home settlement.

You can now personally customize each squad by editing the loadouts of specific squad members, or hiring additional members to a specific squad. All of these changes flow naturally into a squad's effective power, currently calculated from the squad's total value.
Settlements without an assigned squad will defend at half-power when attacked.
There is now support for a settlement to host multiple squads. The mod itself doesn't take advantage of this yet, but it opens some neat doors for the future.

New UI for picking squads to defend a settlement, or to attack an enemy settlement. Estimated enemy power and each squad's estimated win chance are now surfaced in the UI, so offensive operations aren't blind anymore.
Non-Empire NPC settlements now show their estimated military level and efficiency when selected on the world map.
Deployed squads will now immediately follow new orders instead of finishing their previous order first.
Bills can now carry custom late- and unpaid-payment penalties, used for mercenary deployment bills currently.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Refactors
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Various minor backend refactors to clean up the code. There shouldn't be any impact on gameplay.

patchNoteLines.li: Various backend refactors

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Xenotype Cost Modifier Change
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes the cost modifier for xenotypes in the Unit Template maker. Previously, the modifier just multiplied together all of the xenotype's genes' non-zero marketValueFactors. Now, we take various other stats into account: metabolism, complexity, archites, how many abilities the gene grants, stat bonuses, pain bonus, damage resist. All individually weighted with settings sliders.\n\nThe effect from each gene is also added together instead of multiplied. The cost of a xenotype shouldn't explode quite so easily anymore, but supremely powerful xenotypes will still be very expensive.

patchNoteLines.li: Rework the xenotype cost calculation for merc units

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Backend Refactors
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some backend reorganization of the code. Player-facing functionality should not be affected.

patchNoteLines.li: Create a FindFC class, similar to Verse.Find
Pull Tax and Event code out of the FactionFC World Component

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More Backend Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some backend code changes to clean things up. User-facing functionality should not change.

patchNoteLines.li: Backend code changes

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Prisoner Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A polish and balance pass for prisoners.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a prisoner tab to the main tab window, giving an overview of all prisoners in your empire
Prisoners now lose health on a daily basis, instead of on each tax tick
Downed prisoners do not grant a worker bonus
Prisoners at full health no longer magically regrow their legs
Prisoners must be physically transported to the destination settlement and then transfer via world map gizmo. No more magical teleportation

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Merc Needs Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Hardens some of the checks in ResetNeeds to prevent weird modded races from throwing errors.

patchNoteLines.li: Check RaceProps.Humanlike instead of !AnimalOrWildMan

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More Caching
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Makes more use of Def caching. Will this actually produce a notable performance improvement? I doubt it. But at least all our Def grabbing is in one place! ...Just, don't ever hot-reload your defs, please.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds more Def caching to FactionCache

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Vehicle Framework Compat Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue where joining a manual battle with a vehicle and never dismounting the pawns inside can result in both getting silently purged when the battle is over.

patchNoteLines.li: When checking for battle end-state, loop over AllPawnsSpawned with a Faction.OfPlayer filter instead of looping over FreeColonistsSpawned

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Prisoners Update 2
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds some quality-of-life features to prisoner handling, and also a slight balance pass.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds buttons to set the default prisoner workload on a faction and per-settlement basis
Adds buttons to bulk set prisoner workloads on a faction and per-settlement basis
Multiple prisoner deaths at the same settlement are bundled into one letter
Prisoner deaths now grant a -2 relations penalty with the prisoner's home faction

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: No-map Edge case fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an edge-case scenario where tax delivery would error out if the player has no active maps. Technically possible with caravans/nomadic playthroughs.

patchNoteLines.li: Patch DeliveryEvent.Action to check the TaxMap early; if null, go through the safe handling route in PaymentUtil

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Cost Scaling
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds a mod option to scale the silver cost of event options, just in case the values are too low (or high) for your liking.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a mod option to scale silver costs of event options

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Various tweaks and edits to random events.

patchNoteLines.li: Various tweaks and edits to random events

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Military Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Before, the strength of a settlement's defending force was snapshot at the moment a warning letter is sent, and that snapshot is carried forward into the battle. This means that any changes to military level or combat efficiency during the warning window wouldn't actually apply to the coming battle.\n\nThis update changes that. Now, the defending force's strength is recalculated at battle start.

patchNoteLines.li: Recalculate defender strength at the start of a defense battle

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Events Balance Pass
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A broad balance pass to make events harder to cheese: when an event has options, the game auto-pauses and can't be unpaused or saved until an option is chosen. Additionally, the base cost of event options now scales by the number of settlements affected, among other things.

patchNoteLines.li: Force-pause the game when an event with options pops
Scale event option costs by the number of affected settlements, as well as optionally by faction income or resource production
General balance and editing pass for all events

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Fix for pawn generation in battles
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds protection against failed GeneratePawn calls fouling up the map generation for a manual defense battle, which would then crash the game.

patchNoteLines.li: In BattlefieldContext.RecruitMapInhabitants, move the GeneratePawn call into the try/catch block

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: No 3rd-party hostiles in manual defense
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: When generating a manual defense battle, we now loop through all things and destroy any that are hostile to the player. This loop runs before adding hostiles, and is necessary to clean the map of third-party hostiles such as if the settlement was founded on a Launch Point landmark.

patchNoteLines.li: When setting up a defense battle in BattlefieldContext.StartDefense, strip third-party hostiles after generating the map but before setting up the actual attack

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Compatibility Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Update the choose-a-defender dialog to be able to handle defenders from other mods (such as the eventual Vanilla Outposts Expanded compat patch).

patchNoteLines.li: Update Dialog_DefendSettlement to handle non-WorldSettlementFC defenders

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: PlanetTile Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates IRaidTarget to use PlanetTile instead of int.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates IRaidTarget to use PlanetTile instead of int

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Performance Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes some of the Tick functions to exclude comps that don't tick. This has an actual (albeit small) performance improvement for as "few" as 20-30 Empire Settlements.

patchNoteLines.li: Change FactionFC.TickActions to only tick policybehaviors that tick
Override both Tick and TickInterval in WorldSettlementFC to exclude WorldObjectComps that haven't defined their own Ticks (and thus, don't need to tick)

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Animal Selection Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes the list of pack animals to be the list of animals that are allowed in at least one biome's allowedPackAnimals list. Further, the number of biomes that a pack animal supports is shown in their Pack badge on the animal filter. And if the player doesn't select any pack animals that support the biome they're playing in, then the filter will warn them that they won't recieve any Empire trading caravans.

patchNoteLines.li: Various augments to the animal filter to reduce the likelihood of the player encountering Empire caravans that fail to spawn due to not having any animal carriers that support the player's biome

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Biomes! Caverns support
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds official support for the biomes from Biomes! Caverns.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds support for crystalline caverns, earthen depths, and fungal forest from Biomes! Caverns

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Squad Updates: Inventory and Implants!
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds the ability to set a military unit's inventory and implants.

patchNoteLines.li: Augment the unit designer and edit pawn windows to let the player specify the unit's inventory and implants
Fix a bug where squads, on deployment, would immediately try to follow the last order they were given on their previous deployment

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Faction Ideology Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes how the Empire faction's ideology is assigned on creation. It now only has the player's primary ideology, instead of all of the player's ideologies.

patchNoteLines.li: Assign only the player's primary ideology to the Empire faction on creation

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More Stat Modifiers = More Extensibility!
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds numerous new stat modifiers for buildings, policies, and other things to interact with Empire's systems. The design space should open up a good bit!

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: the settlement cost modifier, when added to a biome, would not actually affect the cost of founding a new settlement in that biome
Added stats for building cost base, building cost multiplier, building upkeep base, and building upkeep multiplier. Each has a military and civilian version that stacks
BuildingFCDef has a new IsMilitary field. Moving forward, this field is what determines whether a building is military or civilian

Add numerous other new stats: fireSupportCostMultiplier, policyActionCooldownMultiplier, casualtyWoundSeverityMultiplier, threatAdaptationGrowthMultiplier, battleLossProsperityBase, battleLossHappinessBase, battleLossLoyaltyBase, victoryHappinessBonus, victoryLoyaltyBonus, settlementUpgradeCostBase, settlementUpgradeCostMultiplier, settlementExpansionCostPerSettlement, buildingSlotsPerLevelBonus, workerOverworkPenaltyMultiplier

Add new stat scopes: squads, and units. Stats can now be set to apply their bonuses directly to a military squad or even an individual unit. This feature currently isn't actually used, but it opens the door to some neat future feature

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Biomes! Caverns update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the Biomes! Caverns compat patch.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates the Biomes! Caverns compat patch

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Japanese Translation Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the Japanese translation, courtesy of PhenylPropion.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates Japanese translation

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Mercs Update: Psycasts, Mechs, and Animals, oh my
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fairly substantial update to merc designs: now you can set psycasts, assign mechs, or even have your mercs run around with a pack of animals!

patchNoteLines.li: Squads will now receive their combat efficiency hediff when deployed, not just during manual battles

Added an "Anti-Exploit" setting (default on). When enabled, merc gear is biocoded, and all mercs spawn with Death Acidifiers. This replaces the old Empire behavior where dead mercs would have their corpse and all of their items immediately deleted on death

When determining if an item can be used for mercs or selected for tithing, check the ThingDef's own research fields, not just the recipe. This should filter out modded stuff like Warcasket armor if their research hasn't been unlocked
Mercs can be assigned psylinks. Comes with support for Vanilla Psycasts Expanded
Mercs can be made into mechanitors, and assigned mechs
Mercs can now be assigned more than one animal. This goes out to all of you druid fans out there
Updated Giddy-Up 2 support: if Giddy-Up 2 Continued is enabled, mercs can be assigned a mount, and will spawn riding it

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Migration Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a couple issues with the Empire v1.3 -> v1.5 migration codepaths.

patchNoteLines.li: Fixes a couple of issues with the 1.3 -> 1.5 migration codepaths

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Anti-Exploit Mechanics
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Implements a handful of changes to remove exploits, or otherwise make them more difficult to perform

patchNoteLines.li: Whenever an Empire pawn dies, the pawn's home settlement recieves a temporary happiness penalty. If the pawn's death is caused by the player, then the penalty is more severe, and includes a loyalty or unrest penalty
Killing all of an Empire caravan's pack animals will result in a severe happiness/loyalty penalty
Prevent the player from picking up items belonging to the Empire faction when "visiting" a settlement for a manual defense battle
Prevent the player from caravanaing away with items belonging to the Empire faction when leaving a settlement after a manual defense battle
Add settings to disable most anti-exploit mechanics
Prevent settlements from deploying squads or sending them on raids if the settlement's happiness or loyalty are under 25%, or if its unrest is above 75%
Prosperity now difts toward its target value by distance / 5 (min 1) instead of simply 1 a day. Prosperity will now react more quickly to swift changes in happiness, loyalty, or unrest

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: General Fixes and Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Numerous fixes and minor changes. A 1.5 release to the workshop ought to be soon. Hopefully...

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: add null-guards to patches that touched faction relations
Bugfix: player caravans will not spawn into manual defense battles in the same location as the enemy anymore
Bugfix: in rare cases, manual battles would only end when all defenders die, instead of simply going down
Bugfix: if a merc dies on deployment, their assigned animals might not leave when commanded to, leaving the squad command window open and the squad busy
Settings UI change: give each discrete section its own "Reset to Defaults" button

MILITARY RAIDS CHANGE: the strength of enemy raids on Empire settlements has been reworked. Enemy strength no longer scales by an invisible "Empire Threat Level"; instead, empires will preferentially be raided by enemy factions that are within 2 levels of the empire's average military level
Add Neutroamine to the medicine resource (unlocked by the same research that unlocks industrial medicine)
Compat: when Vanilla Gravships Expanded is enabled, Astrofuel is added to the chemfuel and gravtech resources (gated by Basic Gravtech)
Manual Defense change: manual defense maps are slightly larger by default, and there are settings to let the player further adjust their size
Add a mod setting to block new random events from firing if a multi-step event chain is still in progress
Add mod settings to let the user scale how long it takes for settlements to upgrade, or for buildings to construct
Replace most instances of "empire"/"your empire" with the player empire's actual name or title ("title" is now treated as though it's a polity type, e.g. Kingdom, Republic, Commune)
Update existing Codex entries and add several more
Add a Biomes section to the Codex, showing the resource breakdown for every biome in the game. Supports modded biomes
Minor balance tweaks to Expansionist, Pacifist, and Slavor policies
Various fixes and updates to the various squad UIs (including a dedicated window for hiring squads)

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Extensibility Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A few changes to support features in upcoming submods.

patchNoteLines.li: Backend changes only, user experience should not change.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Features and Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Numerous minor features and fixes, some primarily to help support submods that should release soon.

patchNoteLines.li: In the Tithing section of the settlement window, the Per-Worker tithe modifier now includes the bonus from tithe value multipliers. A tooltip breaks down the math
Prisoners can now be added to a settlement by simply sending them via transport pod
Player caravans no longer have the option to attack Empire settlements
Player caravans should no longer see duplicate Trade options when right-click Empire settlements
Cleaner squad-level UI in the military main tab window
Fix a widespread issue where some numeric bonuses weren't being colorized in tooltips
Fix a handful of UI issues in the "Choose Defender" window

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Changes & Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A few minor updates.

patchNoteLines.li: Updates the loadAfter block in About.xml to list all mods that Empire has a compat patch for, to ensure that we load after all of them

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Further Fixes & Clarity Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple of bug fixes and a handful of UI changes for information clarity.

patchNoteLines.li: Reword the Settlement Military Level tooltip (in the settlement window) to more clearly explain how military level is calculated, and what it derives from
Bugfix: fixed an issue with Mercenary v1.3 -> v1.5 save migration
Bugfix: fixed a niche bug that could result in settlements appearing to disappear from the UI
Add a "Non-Income Resource" header to the settlement window production area, cordoning Research and Power from the list of regular resources
Add a Codex entry for Non-Income Resources, explaining that their income is converted to a faction-wide pool instead of silver
Clean up the settlement window production area when there are enough resources to spawn a scrollbar

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Merc Inventory Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes the list of items that mercs are allowed to carry in their inventory. The new calculation is more permissive, which *should* (ideally) mean fewer necessary compatibility patches with other mods.

patchNoteLines.li: Use a blocklist instead of an allowlist as the base for building the list of items that a merc can carry in their inventory

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Death Penalty Increase
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Increases the penalty for a player killing their Empire's pawns. It really needs to *bite* in order to matter.

patchNoteLines.li: Unhappiness for killing a pawn: 6 -> 12
Penalty magnitude for wiping out a trading caravan: 50 -> 64

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Updates & Merc Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Minor UI and Merc fixes.

patchNoteLines.li: Show the player's available silver in the Found New Settlement dialog

When Merc Squads use items from their inventory or have their weapons or apparel damaged in a fight, they are now restocked afterwards, with the cost being billed to the player (seperate from the cost of deploying)
Change the default Max Concurrent Battle Maps to 3 (instead of Unlimited), and increase the max slider value to 10 (from 5)

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Mod Settings Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the mod settings with the aim of increasing readability and control.

patchNoteLines.li: Condense all of the slider settings to one line, instead of two
Add a numeric text field to all slider settings so the user can input exact values
Use zebra striping and tooltip-signaling mouseover highlights to increase overall readability

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Even More Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Several more fixes and minor changes prior to this week's update.

patchNoteLines.li: Add cooldowns to all random events, including a 60 day cooldown on the infamous Death In The Family event
The Gravtech resource is now locked behind Basic Gravtech

Empire Caravans are now limited in the number of items they stock, which should eliminate the possibility of caravans with tons of pack animals (that likely only would happen with 10+ level settlements anyways)
Fix for minor stat modifier colorizing issues in some UI
Events can be gated by Ideology memes now. Meme-gated options are culled from the list entirely if Ideology isn't active
Add meme-gated options to Dense Wildlife and Widespread Food Shortage events
Bugfix: it was possible for the number of available workers at a settlement to go negative
When an event affects more than 3 settlements, the options window now says merely "N Settlements" (or "All Settlements" if actually all settlements are affected)
The "Assigned Workers" and "Assigned Overmax Workers" boxes in the settlement window now have tooltips listing all active stat modifiers on them

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Just a couple minor last-minute fixes.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: a world object icon caching issue would result in showing old Empire faction settlement icons even if the player loaded a different save
Backend code to help with submod UI rendering - companion windows on the Found New Settlement screen shouldn't stack anymore

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Bugfix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fix a bug caused by renaming certain events

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: some events were renamed between v1.3 and v1.5, causing problems when loading or trying to view the Events tab

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Mercenary Fix for 1.3 -> 1.5
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes an issue with mercenary save migration from Empire Refactored 1.3 -> 1.5.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: a save migration issue would cause mercs to load incorrectly in Empire Refactored v1.5 when loading a v1.3 save

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Fix Japanese Translation
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: The Japanese Translation files were nested one folder too deep, thus never actually showing...

patchNoteLines.li: Pull Japanese language files up to the correct folder depth

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Changes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A couple of minor backend changes. No impact to user-facing behavior.

patchNoteLines.li: A couple of minor backend changes. No impact to user-facing behavior.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Cost Tweak
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes how scaling event costs scale. The old calculation was maybe a bit too much... in the base mod, this only affects the Widespread Food Shortage event.

patchNoteLines.li: When calculating the dynamic cost of an event option, base the cost on the production difference from the free option, rather than on total resource production
